nights.title: Against the Current
nights.name: Against the Current
nights.extract: Against the Current is an American rock band from Poughkeepsie, New York, formed in 2011. As of 2025, the band consists of lead vocalist Chrissy Costanza, guitarist Dan Gow, and drummer Will Ferri. nights.title: Yaelokre
nights.name: Yaelokre
nights.extract: Christopher Kristjansson, known professionally as Keath Ósk, is a Filipino-Icelandic singer-songwriter and multimedia artist known for their folk music storytelling project under the stage name Yaelokre. Ósk began releasing music under the project name in early 2024, going viral on TikTok in July of the same year for their song "Harpy Hare", entering the TikTok Billboard Top 50 and topping Spotify's Global Viral Songs Chart the same year.

nights.title: KAMELOT - DARK ASYLUM WORLD TOUR
nights.name: Kamelot
nights.extract: Kamelot is an American power metal band from Tampa, Florida, formed by Thomas Youngblood in 1987. The Norwegian vocalist Roy Khan joined for the album Siége Perilous, and shared songwriting credit with Youngblood until his departure in April 2011. On June 22, 2012, Youngblood announced on their website that their new vocalist would be the Swedish singer Tommy Karevik, who was first featured on Kamelot's album Silverthorn as the main vocalist, co-songwriter, and lyricist.

nights.title: Dizzee Rascal
nights.name: Dizzee Rascal
nights.extract: Dylan Kwabena Mills, known professionally as Dizzee Rascal, is a British rapper and MC. He is often credited as a pioneer of British hip hop and grime music and was ranked by Complex as one of the greatest British rappers of all time. His work has also incorporated elements of UK garage, bassline and R&B. Dizzee Rascal's music is also often credited with bringing UK rap into the mainstream and became the country's first rapper to achieve international recognition.

nights.title: Ole 60 - Off the Grid Tour
nights.name: Ole 60
nights.extract: Ole 60 is an American country/alt-country band from Hawesville, Kentucky, formed in 2023, known for blending Appalachian storytelling with elements of grunge, southern rock, folk music, and traditional country. The band consists of Jacob Ty Young, Tristan Roby, Ryan Laslie, Colby Clark, Aden Wood (drums), Dwight McGlynn, and Dustin "Catfish" Fuqua. The band gained widespread attention in 2024 through breakout singles like "smoke & a light" and "Thoughts of You", and acclaimed debut album Smokestack Town in 2025.

nights.title: Papa Roach - Rise of the Roach
nights.name: Papa Roach
nights.extract: Papa Roach is an American rock band from Vacaville, California, formed in 1993. After a few early shifts, the band initially stabilized in 1996 with the lineup of lead vocalist Jacoby Shaddix, drummer Dave Buckner, guitarist Jerry Horton, and bassist Tobin Esperance. This lineup remained consistent for slightly over a decade.

nights.title: Wasia Project
nights.name: Wasia Project
nights.extract: Wasia Project is an English indie pop band consisting of siblings Olivia Hardy and William Gao. The group released their debut single, "Why Don't U Love Me," in 2019. On stage, they are often joined by drummer Nate Wicks, bassist Tom Pacitti, saxophonist Safi Jazz, and trombonist Patrick Minton.

nights.title: Teenage Fanclub
nights.name: Teenage Fanclub
nights.extract: Teenage Fanclub are a Scottish alternative rock band formed in Glasgow in 1989. The group was founded by Norman Blake, Raymond McGinley and Gerard Love, all of whom shared lead vocals and songwriting duties until Love's departure in 2018. As of 2023, the band's lineup consists of Blake, McGinley, longtime drummer Francis MacDonald, Dave McGowan and Euros Childs.

2023 itibarıyla kadroda Blake, McGinley, uzun süredir davulcu olan Francis MacDonald, Dave McGowan ve Euros Childs yer alıyor.

nights.title: The Script - The Man In The Arena Tour
nights.name: The Script
nights.extract: The Script are an Irish pop rock band formed in 2001 in Dublin by lead vocalist and keyboardist Danny O'Donoghue, lead guitarist Mark Sheehan and drummer Glen Power. The band currently consists of O'Donoghue, Power, Benjamin Sargeant and Ben Weaver (guitar). Sheehan was a member of the band up until his death in 2023. The band moved to London after signing to Sony Label Group imprint Phonogenic and released their first album The Script in August 2008, preceded by the debut single "We Cry" as well as other singles such as "The Man Who Can't Be Moved", "Breakeven" and "Before the Worst". The album peaked at number one in both Ireland and the UK.

en.who: The Script are an Irish pop rock band formed in 2001 in Dublin. The band moved to London after signing to Sony Label Group imprint Phonogenic.

facts: Die Band besteht aktuell aus O'Donoghue, Power, Benjamin Sargeant und Ben Weaver an der Gitarre.
Das Album erreichte in Irland und Großbritannien jeweils Platz eins.

facts: Grup şu anda O'Donoghue, Power, Benjamin Sargeant ve gitarda Ben Weaver'dan oluşuyor.
Albüm hem İrlanda'da hem Birleşik Krallık'ta birinci sıraya yükseldi.

nights.title: Puscifer
nights.name: Puscifer
nights.extract: Puscifer is an American rock group formed in Los Angeles by Maynard James Keenan, lead singer of Tool and A Perfect Circle. Keenan was the only constant member of the band and he considered the project to be his "creative subconscious". Later, frequent collaborators Mat Mitchell and Carina Round became permanent members.

en.who: Puscifer is an American rock group formed in Los Angeles by Maynard James Keenan, lead singer of Tool and A Perfect Circle. Keenan was the core of the project from the start.
facts: Keenan was the only constant member of the band and he considered the project to be his "creative subconscious".

facts: Keenan war das einzige ständige Mitglied der Band und betrachtete das Projekt als sein kreatives Unterbewusstsein.

tr.who: Puscifer, Los Angeles'ta Tool ve A Perfect Circle'ın baş vokalisti Maynard James Keenan tarafından kurulan Amerikan bir rock grubudur. Keenan, proje boyunca grubun çekirdeğini oluşturdu.
facts: Keenan, grubun tek sabit üyesiydi ve projeyi kendi "creative subconscious" (yaratıcı bilinçaltı) olarak görüyordu.
Daha sonra sık işbirlikçileri Mat Mitchell ve Carina Round kalıcı üye oldu.

nights.title: Mavo
nights.name: Mavo
nights.extract: Oseremen Marvin Ukanigbe, known professionally as Mavo, is a Nigerian singer-songwriter. He rose to popularity in 2025 with the release of the single "Escaladizzy", followed by "Shakabulizzy", "Money Constant" with fellow singer Wizkid, and "Body (Danz)" with CKay, the latter of which became his first number-one song in Nigeria.

nights.title: Stevie Wonder: Songs In The Key of Life Performances
nights.name: Stevie Wonder
nights.extract: Stevland Hardaway Morris, known professionally as Stevie Wonder, is an American singer-songwriter, musician, and record producer. He is widely regarded as one of the most influential musicians of the 20th century, and is credited as a pioneer and influence by musicians across a range of genres that include R&B, pop, soul, gospel, funk, and jazz. Wonder's use of synthesizers and other electronic musical instruments in the 1970s reshaped the conventions of contemporary R&B. He also helped drive such genres into the album era, crafting his LPs as cohesive and consistent, in addition to socially conscious statements with complex compositions.

en.who: Stevland Hardaway Morris, known professionally as Stevie Wonder, is an American singer-songwriter, musician, and record producer. He also helped drive such genres into the album era.
facts: Wonder's use of synthesizers and other electronic musical instruments in the 1970s reshaped the conventions of contemporary R&B.

de.who: Stevland Hardaway Morris, bekannt als Stevie Wonder, ist ein amerikanischer Singer-Songwriter, Musiker und Produzent. Er gilt weithin als einer der einflussreichsten Musiker des 20. Jahrhunderts.
facts: Wonders Einsatz von Synthesizern und anderen elektronischen Instrumenten in den 1970er Jahren hat den zeitgenössischen R&B neu geprägt.
Er gilt als Pionier und Einfluss für Musiker zahlreicher Genres wie R&B, Pop, Soul, Gospel, Funk und Jazz.

tr.who: Stevland Hardaway Morris, Stevie Wonder adıyla bilinen Amerikalı bir şarkıcı-söz yazarı, müzisyen ve plak yapımcısıdır. 20. yüzyılın en etkili müzisyenlerinden biri olarak kabul edilir.
facts: Wonder'ın 1970'lerde sentezleyicileri ve diğer elektronik enstrümanları kullanması, çağdaş R&B'nin geleneklerini yeniden şekillendirdi.
R&B, pop, soul, gospel, funk ve caz gibi birçok türde müzisyenler için öncü ve ilham kaynağı olarak anılır.

nights.title: The Shires
nights.name: The Shires
nights.extract: The Shires are a British country music duo composed of singer-songwriters Ben Earle and Crissie Rhodes. Earle sings harmony vocals, plays piano and guitar, and Rhodes is lead singer. The duo formed in 2013 and released their debut album Brave in 2015, becoming the first British country act to chart in the Top 10 of the UK Albums Chart. The group's second album, My Universe, became the fastest-selling British country album in history when it was released in October 2016.

en.who: The Shires are a British country music duo composed of singer-songwriters Ben Earle and Crissie Rhodes. Earle sings harmony vocals, plays piano and guitar, and Rhodes is lead singer.

de.who: The Shires sind ein britisches Country-Musik-Duo aus den Singer-Songwritern Ben Earle und Crissie Rhodes. Earle singt Harmoniegesang und spielt Klavier und Gitarre, Rhodes ist die Leadsängerin.
facts: Das Duo gründete sich 2013 und veröffentlichte 2015 sein Debütalbum Brave, womit es als erste britische Country-Band in die Top 10 der UK Albums Chart einstieg.
Das zweite Album My Universe wurde im Oktober 2016 veröffentlicht und wurde das schnellstverkaufte britische Country-Album der Geschichte.

tr.who: The Shires, şarkıcı-söz yazarları Ben Earle ve Crissie Rhodes'tan oluşan İngiliz bir country müzik ikilisidir. Earle armoni vokalleri söyler ve piyano ile gitar çalar; Rhodes ise baş vokalisttir.
facts: İkili 2013'te kuruldu ve 2015'te ilk albümü Brave'i yayımlayarak UK Albums Chart'ın ilk 10'una giren ilk İngiliz country sanatçısı oldu.
İkinci albümleri My Universe, Ekim 2016'da yayımlandığında tarihin en hızlı satan İngiliz country albümü oldu.

nights.title: Noah Kahan - The Great Divide Tour
nights.name: Noah Kahan
nights.extract: Noah Berkenkamp Kahan is an American singer-songwriter. His breakthrough single, "Hurt Somebody", achieved gold status in the United States and charted in multiple international markets. The single and EP of the same name preceded the release of his debut album, Busyhead (2019). Within five years, two more albums came out: I Was / I Am (2021) and Stick Season (2022), the latter became his mainstream commercial breakthrough. It led to his nomination in 2023 for the Grammy Award for Best New Artist. In 2026, his fourth album The Great Divide was released and achieved record-breaking streaming and vinyl sales for a No. 1 rock album debut on the Billboard 200. That preceded The Great Divide Tour

2023'te Grammy Ödülü'nde En İyi Yeni Sanatçı (Best New Artist) dalında aday gösterildi.

nights.title: Hothouse Flowers
nights.name: Hothouse Flowers
nights.extract: Hothouse Flowers is an Irish rock band that combine traditional Irish music with influences from soul, gospel, and rock. Formed in 1985 in Dublin, they began as street performers. Their first album, People (1988), was the most successful debut album in Irish history, reaching No. 1 in Ireland and No. 2 in the UK. After two more albums and extensive touring, the group separated in 1994. Since reforming in 1998, the band members have sporadically toured and issued new songs, but also have pursued solo careers.

en.who: Hothouse Flowers is an Irish rock band that combine traditional Irish music with influences from soul, gospel, and rock. The group separated in 1994 and has reformed since 1998.
facts: Formed in 1985 in Dublin, they began as street performers.

tr.who: Hothouse Flowers, geleneksel İrlanda müziğini soul, gospel ve rock etkileriyle harmanlayan bir İrlanda rock grubudur. Grup 1994'te dağıldı ve 1998'de yeniden bir araya geldi.
facts: Grup 1985'te Dublin'de kuruldu ve sokak sanatçısı olarak başladı.
İlk albümleri People (1988), İrlanda tarihinin en başarılı debut albümü oldu; İrlanda'da 1, İngiltere'de 2 numaraya yükseldi.

nights.title: Chasing Abbey
nights.name: Chasing Abbey
nights.extract: Chasing Abbey are an Irish music group combining electronic production with influences from traditional Irish music. They formed in Tullamore, Ireland, in 2016 and the group consists of members Ronan Bell, Jonathan Byrne and Ted Conway. The trio first gained attention with their debut single "That Good Thing" in 2017, securing the band a record deal with 3 Beat UK and Universal Music Group. Their next EP, The Oddessy Project, debuted at number one on the Irish Music Charts in 2019. Following the release of their song "Oh My Johnny" in 2023, Chasing Abbey signed a record deal with Warner and dance label Spinnin' Records. Their debut album, Cyber Celt, was released on 18th September 2026.

facts: Die Gruppe gründete sich 2016 in Tullamore, Irland, und besteht aus Ronan Bell, Jonathan Byrne und Ted Conway.
